```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

data_dir <- here::here("data/malta")

# ── try loading each required .rds object ─────────────────────────────────────
load_rds <- function(name, path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message(sprintf("MISSING: %s (%s)", name, path))
    NULL
  }
}

malta_survey_summary <- load_rds("malta_survey_summary",
                                  file.path(data_dir, "outputs", "malta_survey_summary.rds"))
klag_survey_summary  <- load_rds("klag_survey_summary",
                                  file.path(data_dir, "outputs", "klag_survey_summary.rds"))
malta_sensitivity    <- load_rds("malta_sensitivity",
                                  file.path(data_dir, "malta_sensitivity.rds"))
klag_sensitivity     <- load_rds("klag_sensitivity",
                                  file.path(data_dir, "klag_sensitivity.rds"))

# ── track which objects are present ───────────────────────────────────────────
obj_status <- list(
  malta_survey_summary = !is.null(malta_survey_summary),
  klag_survey_summary  = !is.null(klag_survey_summary),
  malta_sensitivity    = !is.null(malta_sensitivity),
  klag_sensitivity     = !is.null(klag_sensitivity)
)

# ── shared helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
format_pval <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "—",
         ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.2f", p)))
}

# alternating grey on odd body rows
shade_rows <- function(kbl, n, colour = "#F2F2F2") {
  row_spec(kbl, row = seq(1, n, by = 2), background = colour)
}

booktabs_style <- function(kbl, font = 9) {
  kable_styling(kbl,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    font_size         = font
  )
}
```

# Table 1 — Criteria and Indicators

```{r table1}
t1_data <- tibble(

    "Both",

PRELIMINARY: the per-person availability indicator currently uses a Euclidean-distance proxy pending the network-routed E2SFCA pipeline.",

)
```

# Table 2 — Top-quintile indicator contributions

```{r table2-topquintile, results='asis'}
library(sf)
library(purrr)

outputs_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "outputs")

# ── load grids and survey summaries ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Reallocated population version (canonical for Malta; same criteria and priority_citizen as
# the non reallocated file, checked 2026-11-03)
malta_grid <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "malta_mcda_processed_realloc.rds"))
klag_grid  <- readRDS(here::here("data/klagenfurt/klagenfurt_mcda_priority_may.rds"))
malta_srv  <- readRDS(file.path(outputs_dir, "malta_survey_summary.rds"))
klag_srv   <- readRDS(file.path(outputs_dir, "klag_survey_summary.rds"))

# ── indicator → norm-column mappings \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500
# Malta: survey_criterion uses dot-encoded names (read.csv converts hyphens)
malta_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~display_label,              ~norm_col,         ~survey_criterion,
  "Urban heat",                "norm_lst",         "urban.heat",
  "Street greenery",           "norm_tree",        "lack.street.greenery",
  "Grey infrastructure",       "norm_imd",         "grey.infrastracture",
  "Traffic",                   "norm_traffic",     "traffic.dominance",
  "Air quality (NO2)",         "norm_no2",         "poor.airquality",
  "Noise",                     "norm_Lden",        "noise.pollution",
  "Green space proximity",     "norm_green_time",  "poor.accessibility",
  "Blue space access",         "norm_dist_bs",     "lack.blue.spaces",
  "Recreational facilities",   "norm_dist_rec",    "Lack.recreational.facilities",
  "Green space overcrowding",  "norm_green_suff",  "overcrowding"
)

# Klagenfurt: air quality weight is split equally between NO2 and PM2.5
klag_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~display_label,                ~norm_col,              ~survey_criterion,
  "Urban heat",                  "norm_lst",              "alloc_1_TooHotStreets",
  "Green space proximity",       "norm_green_time",       "alloc_2_GreenOutOfReach",
  "Low income",                  "norm_income_weighted",  "alloc_3_LowIncomeNeighborhoods",
  "Traffic",                     "norm_traffic_cat",      "alloc_4_HighTrafficAreas",
  "Air quality (NO2)",           "norm_no2",              "alloc_5_PoorAirQuality_half",
  "Air quality (PM2.5)",         "norm_pm25",             "alloc_5_PoorAirQuality_half",
  "Blue space access",           "norm_dist_bs",          "alloc_6_DisconnectedNatureWater"
)

# ── diagnostic: which norm columns are present \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500
malta_present <- malta_map$norm_col[malta_map$norm_col %in% names(malta_grid)]
malta_missing <- malta_map$norm_col[!malta_map$norm_col %in% names(malta_grid)]
klag_present  <- klag_map$norm_col[klag_map$norm_col  %in% names(klag_grid)]
klag_missing  <- klag_map$norm_col[!klag_map$norm_col %in% names(klag_grid)]

cat("<div style=\'font-family:monospace;font-size:0.85em;border:1px solid #ccc;",
    "padding:10px;background:#fafafa;margin-bottom:12px;\'\n>\n")
cat("<strong>Diagnostic \u2014 norm columns in grid objects</strong><br><br>\n")
cat("<b>Malta FOUND:</b>", paste(malta_present, collapse=", "), "<br>\n")
if (length(malta_missing)) {
  cat("<b style=\'color:#c0392b\'>Malta MISSING:</b>",
      paste(malta_missing, collapse=", "), "<br>\n")
  cat("&nbsp;&nbsp;<em>TODO: norm_green_suff is computed inside Malta_MCDA_260504.Rmd",
      "but not saved to malta_mcda_processed.rds.",
      "Add norm_green_suff to the saveRDS() call to populate this cell.</em><br>\n")
} else {
  cat("Malta MISSING: none<br>\n")
}
cat("<b>Klagenfurt FOUND:</b>", paste(klag_present,  collapse=", "), "<br>\n")
if (length(klag_missing)) {
  cat("<b style=\'color:#c0392b\'>Klagenfurt MISSING:</b>",
      paste(klag_missing, collapse=", "), "<br>\n")
} else {
  cat("Klagenfurt MISSING: none<br>\n")
}
cat("</div>\n")

# ── extract top-quintile cells (quintile 5 of 5) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500
malta_q5 <- malta_grid %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(quintile = ntile(priority_citizen, 5)) %>%
  filter(quintile == 5)

klag_q5 <- klag_grid %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(quintile = ntile(priority_citizen, 5)) %>%
  filter(quintile == 5)

cat(sprintf(
  "<p style=\'font-size:0.85em;color:#555\'>Top-quintile cells \u2014 Malta: %d &nbsp;|&nbsp; Klagenfurt: %d</p>\n",
  nrow(malta_q5), nrow(klag_q5)
))

# ── build weights vectors \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500
# Malta: one proportion per criterion (sum to 1)
malta_w <- setNames(malta_srv$mean_pct / 100, malta_srv$criterion)

# Klagenfurt: air quality split 50/50; use a shared pseudo-criterion key
klag_w_base  <- setNames(klag_srv$mean_pct / 100, klag_srv$criterion)
klag_aq_half <- as.numeric(klag_w_base["alloc_5_PoorAirQuality"]) / 2

# ── compute mean(norm | Q5) x weight per indicator \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500
compute_contributions <- function(map_df, q5_df, w_named, aq_half = NULL) {
  purrr::pmap_dfr(map_df, function(display_label, norm_col, survey_criterion) {
    mean_val <- if (norm_col %in% names(q5_df)) {
      mean(q5_df[[norm_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    wt <- if (survey_criterion == "alloc_5_PoorAirQuality_half") {
      aq_half
    } else {
      as.numeric(w_named[survey_criterion])
    }
    tibble::tibble(
      display_label = display_label,
      norm_col      = norm_col,
      mean_norm_q5  = mean_val,
      weight        = wt,
      contribution  = mean_val * wt
    )
  })
}

malta_contrib <- compute_contributions(malta_map, malta_q5, malta_w)
klag_contrib  <- compute_contributions(klag_map,  klag_q5,  klag_w_base,
                                        aq_half = klag_aq_half)

# ── assemble cross-city table \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500
# Row order: sorted by descending Klagenfurt contribution, Malta-only at bottom
row_order <- c(
  "Urban heat",
  "Blue space access",
  "Air quality (PM2.5)",
  "Air quality (NO2)",
  "Green space proximity",
  "Low income",
  "Traffic",
  "Street greenery",
  "Grey infrastructure",
  "Green space overcrowding",
  "Recreational facilities",
  "Noise"
)

malta_vals <- malta_contrib %>%
  select(display_label, malta_contribution = contribution)

klag_vals <- klag_contrib %>%
  select(display_label, klag_contribution = contribution)

t2_data <- tibble(display_label = row_order) %>%
  left_join(malta_vals, by = "display_label") %>%
  left_join(klag_vals,  by = "display_label") %>%
  mutate(
    malta_fmt = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(malta_contribution) & display_label == "Green space overcrowding" ~
        cell_spec("NA", color = "#c0392b", italic = TRUE),
      is.na(malta_contribution) ~ "\u2014",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", malta_contribution)
    ),
    klag_fmt = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(klag_contribution) ~ "\u2014",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", klag_contribution)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Criterion = display_label, Malta = malta_fmt, Klagenfurt = klag_fmt)

# ── render table \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500
caption_txt <- paste(
  "Table 2. Mean contribution of each spatial indicator to the priority score",
  "within top-quintile cells, by city. Contribution = mean normalized indicator",
  "value \u00d7 citizen weight, calculated across cells in the highest priority",
  "quintile (quintile 5 of 5). Dashes indicate criteria not included in that",
  "city\u2019s framework."
)

tbl2 <- kable(
  t2_data,
  format    = "html",
  booktabs  = TRUE,
  linesep   = "",
  escape    = FALSE,
  caption   = caption_txt,
  col.names = c("Criterion", "Malta", "Klagenfurt"),
  align     = c("l", "r", "r")
) %>%
  booktabs_style() %>%
  row_spec(0, background = "#595959", color = "white", bold = TRUE) %>%
  shade_rows(nrow(t2_data)) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "6cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:3, width = "3cm")

tbl2

footnote(
  tbl2,
  general = paste(
    "In Klagenfurt, the air quality citizen weight (15.9%) is split equally between",
    "NO\u2082 and PM\u2082.\u2085 (8.0% each). Top-quintile cells: highest 20% of cells by",
    "citizen-weighted WLC score within each city.",
    "Malta per-person availability values are preliminary (Euclidean-distance proxy)."
  ),
  general_title     = "",
  footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
)

# ── save outputs \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500
contribution_table <- tibble(display_label = row_order) %>%
  left_join(
    malta_contrib %>% select(display_label, malta_contribution = contribution,
                              malta_weight = weight, malta_mean_norm = mean_norm_q5),
    by = "display_label"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    klag_contrib %>% select(display_label, klag_contribution = contribution,
                              klag_weight = weight, klag_mean_norm = mean_norm_q5),
    by = "display_label"
  )

saveRDS(contribution_table,
        file.path(outputs_dir, "contribution_table.rds"))
save_kable(tbl2, "Table2_topquintile.html", self_contained = TRUE)
```

# Supplementary Table S5 — Full citizen allocations

```{r tableS5}
if (is.null(malta_survey_summary) || is.null(klag_survey_summary)) {

  cat("> **WARNING — Table S5 skipped:** one or both of `malta_survey_summary` and",
      "`klag_survey_summary` are missing. See the build-status checklist above.\n")

} else {

  bench_malta <- 100 / 10
  bench_klag  <- 100 / 6

  make_sig_col <- function(df, bench) {
    df %>%
      mutate(sig = case_when(
        mean_pct > bench & p_value < 0.05 ~ cell_spec("\u2191", bold = TRUE),
        mean_pct < bench & p_value < 0.05 ~ cell_spec("\u2193", bold = TRUE),
        TRUE ~ ""
      ))
  }

  s5_malta <- malta_survey_summary %>%
    mutate(City = "Malta") %>%
    make_sig_col(bench_malta) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_pct))

  s5_klag <- klag_survey_summary %>%
    mutate(City = "Klagenfurt") %>%
    make_sig_col(bench_klag) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_pct))

  s5_data <- bind_rows(s5_malta, s5_klag) %>%
    mutate(
      mean_pct   = round(mean_pct, 1),
      ci_lower   = round(ci_lower, 1),
      ci_upper   = round(ci_upper, 1),
      t_stat     = round(t_stat, 2),
      p_fmt      = format_pval(p_value)
    ) %>%
    select(
      City, Criterion = label,
      `Mean (%)` = mean_pct,
      `95% CI lower` = ci_lower,
      `95% CI upper` = ci_upper,
      `t-statistic`  = t_stat,
      `p-value`      = p_fmt,
      `Sig.`         = sig
    )

  tbl_s5 <- kable(
    s5_data,
    format   = "html",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    linesep  = "",
    escape   = FALSE,
    caption  = "Supplementary Table S5. Full citizen budget allocations and one-sample t-test results for all criteria, both cities."
  ) %>%
    booktabs_style() %>%
    row_spec(0, background = "#595959", color = "white", bold = TRUE) %>%
    shade_rows(nrow(s5_data)) %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "12%") %>%
    column_spec(2, width = "28%") %>%
    column_spec(3, width = "10%") %>%
    column_spec(4, width = "12%") %>%
    column_spec(5, width = "12%") %>%
    column_spec(6, width = "12%") %>%
    column_spec(7, width = "10%") %>%
    column_spec(8, width = "4%")

  tbl_s5

  save_kable(tbl_s5, "TableS5_full_allocations.html", self_contained = TRUE)
}
```

# Supplementary Table S6 — Sensitivity summary

```{r tableS6}
if (is.null(malta_sensitivity) || is.null(klag_sensitivity)) {

  cat("> **WARNING — Table S6 skipped:** one or both of `malta_sensitivity` and",
      "`klag_sensitivity` are missing. See the build-status checklist above.\n")

} else {

  # Combine cities and flag NA cells
  s6_data <- bind_rows(
    malta_sensitivity %>% mutate(City = "Malta"),
    klag_sensitivity  %>% mutate(City = "Klagenfurt")
  ) %>%
    select(City, `Sensitivity test` = test_name,
           `Spearman r` = spearman_r,
           `Top-quintile class agreement (%)` = class_agreement)

  # Apply yellow highlight to NA cells
  s6_display <- s6_data %>%
    mutate(
      `Spearman r` = ifelse(
        is.na(`Spearman r`),
        cell_spec("TODO", background = "#FFFACD", bold = TRUE),
        `Spearman r`
      ),
      `Top-quintile class agreement (%)` = ifelse(
        is.na(`Top-quintile class agreement (%)`),
        cell_spec("TODO", background = "#FFFACD", bold = TRUE),
        `Top-quintile class agreement (%)`
      )
    )

  tbl_s6 <- kable(
    s6_display,
    format   = "html",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    linesep  = "",
    escape   = FALSE,
    caption  = "Supplementary Table S6. Summary of sensitivity analyses. Spearman rank correlation between the baseline citizen-weighted priority surface and each alternative specification, across all grid cells. Class agreement = percentage of top-quintile cells in the baseline that remain in the top quintile under the alternative specification."
  ) %>%
    booktabs_style() %>%
    row_spec(0, background = "#595959", color = "white", bold = TRUE) %>%
    shade_rows(nrow(s6_display)) %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "12%") %>%
    column_spec(2, width = "45%") %>%
    column_spec(3, width = "20%") %>%
    column_spec(4, width = "23%")

  tbl_s6

  save_kable(tbl_s6, "TableS6_sensitivity_summary.html", self_contained = TRUE)
}
```
